Subject: Notes & actions: SIG / CAIQ session (11/18)

Hi Elena / Prime Protocol team — thanks for the session today. Below is a concise digest of what we covered and agreed next steps. Recording and slides attached.

Meeting summary (45 min):
- Agenda: CAIQ control mapping (network, KMS, logging), Q&A on data residency, evidence handoff process.
- Redwood participants: Grace (lead), Connor, Ben, Hannah. Prime Protocol: Elena and procurement (compliance@primeprotocol.com).

Key technical points:
- Network: Redwood uses isolated VPC per-tenant for Dedicated, with egress controls and optional customer-managed VPC peering for Private. We shared high-level network_diagram_v2.pdf during call.
- Logging: Application logs are routed to a tenant-specific logging pipeline (S3 + time-series). Retention defaults: 90 days for verbose logs, 365 days for retention-eligible telemetry. We attached an anonymized sample (requested-logs-sample.txt).
- KMS: We support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integrations (AWS KMS or external HSM through our key-wrap). Rotation cadence is customer-controlled; Redwood supports daily rotation windows if required.
- SOC 2: Latest attestation (2026) available on request; we've linked the HubSpot record for the compliance packet.

Action items (owner — due):
- Grace: Upload CAIQ mapping spreadsheet with control references + pointer to SOC 2 report (due 2026-11-20).
- Hannah: Provide sanitized log sample and short note on retention/config (due 2026-11-19).
- Connor/Ben: Share commercial margin/throughput sizing doc for Dedicated capacity (Ben) and send follow-up calendar with HubSpot link (Connor) (due 2026-11-22).
- Elena: Confirm whether Prime Protocol needs a scoped auditor contact or additional encryption proofs (due 2026-11-23).

Attachments (shared): meeting-notes-20261118.pdf, network_diagram_v2.pdf, requested-logs-sample.txt
Links: https://hubspot.com/deal/HP-8921 (procurement packet), https://zoom.us/rec/meeting/abcd-efgh-20261118 (recording)

Thanks — we'll follow up with the CAIQ mapping and the SOC 2 pointer by Friday. If you'd like a separate breakout on KMS/HSM details, Grace is happy to set a short technical deep-dive.

Regards,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com
